# Lab 4.23: Configure Workforce Identity Federation

## What We Are Going to Do
Let users from an external OIDC identity provider sign in to the Google Cloud console without Cloud Identity accounts.

## Steps

1. **Create an OIDC app in your IdP.** In your Okta account, create an **OIDC Web Application**. Set the sign-in redirect URI to `https://auth.cloud.google/signin-callback/locations/global/workforcePools/lab-wf-pool/providers/lab-okta`. Copy the **Client ID** and your Okta **Issuer URL**, for example `https://YOUR_OKTA_DOMAIN.okta.com`.

2. **Create the workforce pool** at organization level.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam workforce-pools create lab-wf-pool \
  --organization=ORG_ID \
  --location=global \
  --display-name="Lab workforce pool" \
  --session-duration=3600s</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Add the OIDC provider.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam workforce-pools providers create-oidc lab-okta \
  --workforce-pool=lab-wf-pool \
  --location=global \
  --display-name="Okta" \
  --issuer-uri="https://YOUR_OKTA_DOMAIN.okta.com" \
  --client-id="OKTA_CLIENT_ID" \
  --attribute-mapping="google.subject=assertion.sub,google.display_name=assertion.email" \
  --web-sso-response-type=id-token \
  --web-sso-assertion-claims-behavior=only-id-token-claims</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Grant access to the whole pool.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --role=roles/viewer \
  --member="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/locations/global/workforcePools/lab-wf-pool/*"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Sign in.** Open this URL in a private window and sign in with your Okta user:
   `https://auth.cloud.google/signin/locations/global/workforcePools/lab-wf-pool/providers/lab-okta?continueUrl=https://console.cloud.google/`

6. **Check the audit log.** In **Logging → Logs Explorer**, search for `principal://iam.googleapis.com/locations/global/workforcePools/lab-wf-pool`. Actions show the federated identity.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam workforce-pools delete lab-wf-pool --location=global</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Cloud Identity accounts | Not needed for federated users |
| Pool scope | Organization level |
| Console URL | Federated users use `console.cloud.google` |
| Audit | Actions logged with the federated principal |
